notes: MVP uses HP cost only; no durability/stamina costs yet.
Player-only command flow lands in a follow-up scene update.
All catalog mechanics are implemented; structured effects live in each art's effects/combatMods blocks (no deferred placeholders remain).

arts.name: Precise Cut
arts.description: Two HP buys a surer edge: +20 Hit, +5 Crit.

arts.name: Wrath Strike
arts.description: Anger sharpens the swing, adding might and hit.

arts.name: Dueling Blade
arts.description: A duelist's guard turns aside almost any blow.

arts.name: Grounder
arts.description: Low sweep meant for wings, triple damage to fliers.

arts.name: Advancing Strike
arts.description: A lunge that ends with a free step into the gap.

arts.name: Comet Edge
arts.description: The old duelists' finisher, all precision and crit.

arts.name: Windsweep
arts.description: So fast the enemy never gets to answer it.

arts.name: Hexblade
arts.description: Cursed steel that bites resistance, not armor.

arts.name: Lunge
arts.description: The thrust ends with you and the target trading places.

arts.name: Seal Speed
arts.description: Its cut leaves the target 4 Speed slower.

arts.name: Poison Strike
arts.description: Venom on the edge eats 5 more HP once blades part.

arts.name: Finesse Blade
arts.description: The keener your skill, the harder this one lands.

arts.name: Shadow Gambit
arts.description: Feint past cover the ground can no longer shield.

arts.name: Dragonhaze
arts.description: Faster hands mean a heavier blow; it scales on Speed.

arts.name: Astra Strike
arts.description: Three blurred cuts, each landing at sixty percent.

arts.name: Piercing Drive
arts.description: Puts the whole body behind one thrust, for might and aim.

arts.name: Tempest Lance
arts.description: One surging thrust, all momentum and raw attack power.

arts.name: Countering Strike
arts.description: Guard behind the shaft; the next blow finds you harder.

arts.name: Hit and Run
arts.description: Strike and step back a tile before the counter.

arts.name: Vaulting Thrust
arts.description: Vault into the point so weight and reach add to it.

arts.name: Knightkneeler
arts.description: Aimed at the legs, it drops cavalry mid-charge.

arts.name: Vengeance
arts.description: The more blood you've lost, the more this thrust repays.

arts.name: Shatter Slash
arts.description: Splits the guard so DEF stays down after the clash.

arts.name: Glowing Ember
arts.description: Heavier armor feeds the flame, and helps you dodge.

arts.name: Longearche
arts.description: Held long, the lance threatens tiles one and two out.

arts.name: Overrun
arts.description: Bowls the target back a full tile on impact.

arts.name: Wild Swing
arts.description: Big damage, loose aim, and the axe goes where it will.

arts.name: Smash
arts.description: Reckless overhead swing with +20 Hit and +20 Crit.

arts.name: Gamble
arts.description: Trade accuracy for raw power and pray it lands.

arts.name: Helm Splitter
arts.description: Overhead blow that splits plate, triple to armored.

arts.name: Rending Cleave
arts.description: The axe's own weight drags it down through the guard.

arts.name: Diamond Axe
arts.description: Enormous force, clumsy aim: +14 might, -10 Hit.

arts.name: Wild Abandon
arts.description: Nothing held back, wild power and +30 Crit.

arts.name: Rushing Blow
arts.description: The charge carries clean through the enemy's square.

arts.name: War Cry
arts.description: A roar that lends nearby allies +3 Strength.

arts.name: Armored Strike
arts.description: The heavier your armor, the harder this one lands.

arts.name: Pavise Strike
arts.description: Fight behind the haft and take back half the blow.

arts.name: Rallying Blow
arts.description: Nearby allies rally for +3 Strength and +10 Crit.

arts.name: Longshot
arts.description: Sight down the shaft for a cleaner, deadlier shot.

arts.name: Curved Shot
arts.description: Arced over cover, it flies farther and rarely misses.

arts.name: Heavy Draw
arts.description: Draw to full and let the bow's weight do the rest.

arts.name: Hunter's Focus
arts.description: One steadied breath sharpens aim, edge, and speed.

arts.name: Encloser
arts.description: Pins the target where it stands for one turn.

arts.name: Ward Arrow
arts.description: Fletched against magic, it gags a caster for a turn.

arts.name: Break Shot
arts.description: An arrow to the joints leaves DEF lowered.

arts.name: Waning Shot
arts.description: Wound the arm and the target strikes weaker after.

arts.name: Seal Magic
arts.description: Rattle a caster and their MAG sags after the shot.

arts.name: Deadeye
arts.description: Reaches three tiles farther, though the aim strains.

arts.name: All or Nothing
arts.description: Everything on one shot: double on a hit, blood on a miss.

arts.name: Hunter's Volley
arts.description: Looses two arrows in a breath, each near full force.

arts.name: Focused Bolt
arts.description: Narrow the cast to a point for more force and aim.

arts.name: Resonance
arts.description: The stronger the mind, the stronger the bolt it hurls.

arts.name: Purifying Light
arts.description: Holy light gathered and loosed with added force.

arts.name: Seraphim
arts.description: Sacred fire scours armored foes, striking at their RES.

arts.name: Healing Light
arts.description: Wounds the enemy and mends you for a third of it.

arts.name: Mire
arts.description: Casts two tiles out, at some cost to accuracy.

arts.name: Burning Quake
arts.description: The ground erupts, scorching enemies around the mark.

arts.name: Radiant Burst
arts.description: Light flares wide enough to catch one foe alongside.

arts.name: Silence Strike
arts.description: Chokes off the target's magic for two full turns.

arts.name: Nosferatu
arts.description: Dark words drink the wound whole and pour it into you.

arts.name: Gemini Tempest
arts.description: Gemini's own flurry, honed for its twin edges.

arts.name: Starfall Volley
arts.description: Starfall and Doublebow answer in a burst of arrows.

arts.name: Phantom Rush
arts.description: Brave Sword blurs into three cuts, then leaves you at 5 HP.

arts.name: Piercing Charge
arts.description: Brave Lance strikes twice and drives clean through.

arts.name: Galeforce Assault
arts.description: Brave Axe's triple storm buffs allies and drops you to 5 HP.

arts.name: Barrage
arts.description: Brave Bow rains twice, catching foes beside the mark.

arts.name: Storm Blade
arts.description: Ragnarok's whirl: two cuts, no reply, then a step clear.

arts.name: Life Drain
arts.description: Soulreaver feeds; 150% of the wound comes back as HP.

arts.name: Doom Thrust
arts.description: Doomblade runs one foe through and shoves it back.

arts.name: Blood Lance
arts.description: Gae Bolg drinks your wounds, guts cavalry, rallies allies.

arts.name: Cataclysm
arts.description: Stormbreaker splits the ground: huge power, wide splash.

arts.name: Annihilate
arts.description: Ruin ignores the triangle; a kill leaves you +4 Str/+4 Spd.

arts.name: Tempest
arts.description: Excalibur's gale tears fliers down and spreads outward.

arts.name: Cataclysm Bolt
arts.description: Bolting calls thunder down across two tiles.

arts.name: Divine Flare
arts.description: Luce's light ignores RES and burns dark things away.
